description: Election Commission - Y. A. R. Kumara was Selected as the Member of the Kamburupitiya P.S.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Kamburupitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
